Thanks — a couple notes on the MFA/OTP failure:
- The portal's OTP flow throttles after three failed attempts and will reject requests when the account is not yet provisioned in the IdP. That matches the screenshot.
- To avoid escalation, when we reissue the invite we'll set the initial auth method to phone verification (SMS) and also allow a backup email OTP for the first sign-in. If SMS is blocked for the user, we'll do a short live phone verification by procurement/security (we do this ~rarely for high-volume vendors).

Rachel, please reassign the admin in the vendor console, attach the W-9 to the profile, and resend the invite to payables@acmeprinting.com with SMS-first enabled. Greg — please confirm the phone number for the admin who will complete MFA.

Karthik Iyer
Security & Compliance (Identity)
Redwood Inference
karthik.iyer@redwood.ai
